question: What personalised gene-editing treatment did baby KJ Muldoon receive, as reported in 2025?
text: Baby KJ Muldoon received a **personalised CRISPR base-editing therapy** designed to correct a specific mutation in his *CPS1* gene. The editor was delivered to his liver cells in lipid nanoparticles to treat severe carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1 (CPS1) deficiency, a rare disorder that causes toxic ammonia to build up in the blood. He received his first dose in February 2025. ([chop.edu](https://www.chop.edu/news/worlds-first-patient-treated-personalized-crispr-gene-editing-therapy-childrens-hospital?utm_source=openai))
